info.title: The Surrogacy
info.synopsis: Quando una donna di umili origini viene costretta alla maternità surrogata, rimane invischiata in una famiglia benestante che proteggerà la propria reputazione a tutti i costi.

episodes.name: Episodio 1
episodes.plot: An attempt to kidnap Yeni is foiled, but gives Julia the upper hand. Marcela tries to quit. Nora decides to withhold key details about the pregnancy.

episodes.name: Episodio 2
episodes.plot: A murder occurs, shocking everyone. Marcela receives an alarming call. While Yeni prepares to flee, Julia and Carlos attend a funeral.

episodes.name: Episodio 3
episodes.plot: Yeni must take on a heartbreaking task. Julia confronts Carlos, who notices something striking on the baby's body. Yeni refuses to accept a letter.

episodes.name: Episodio 4
episodes.plot: Nora tries to intimidate Marcela. Both Julia and Nora drag Yeni further into a web of lies and inaccuracies. Yeni entrusts Sonia with an intimate detail.

episodes.name: Episodio 5
episodes.plot: Yeni heads to the pier to meet a stranger. Julia learns the truth about the baby. New facts come to light about Fernanda’s hand in Julia’s treatment.

episodes.name: Episodio 6
episodes.plot: Carlos continua a essere profondamente perplesso riguardo alla situazione. Arturo dà la colpa a Fer del destino di Yeni. Vengono rivelati i dettagli del macabro piano di Nora.

translations.value: Carlos continua a essere profondamente perplesso riguardo alla situazione. Arturo dà la colpa a Fer del destino di Yeni. Vengono rivelati i dettagli del macabro piano di Nora.

episodes.name: Episodio 7
episodes.plot: Nora warns Fer, Arturo and Julia that further consequences will unfold. Yeni learns that Sonia and Carlos are texting. A funeral scandal makes the news.

episodes.name: Episodio 8
episodes.plot: Fer behaves brazenly, enraging Julia. Nora's ruthlessness — and Yeni’s mistrust of Carlos — grow exponentially. A new tragedy strikes the Ochoas.

episodes.name: Episodio 9
episodes.plot: Cuca is nowhere to be found. Marcela finds it suspicious that Julia isn’t fighting for the baby. Carlos confronts Julia about what Yeni was put through.

episodes.name: Episodio 10
episodes.plot: Nora plots to exacerbate Beatriz’s pain. Yeni and Nora reach an agreement. Marcela wants to speak with Julia, but warns her of possible repercussions.

episodes.name: Episodio 11
episodes.plot: Nora and Arturo concoct a strategy to destroy Yeni’s support network. Nora persuades Julia to threaten Carlos. Yeni makes a bold move.

episodes.name: Episodio 12
episodes.plot: Yeni is abducted. Julia tells Yeni that what Marcela shared with her isn't true. Information about Irene’s romantic life comes to light.

episodes.name: Episodio 13
episodes.plot: Yeni realizes that if she doesn't hold up her end of the deal, it could put the baby in danger. Roberto is forced to make a weighty choice.

episodes.name: Episodio 14
episodes.plot: Carlos demands that Julia come clean. Beatriz breaks down while visiting Andrés. David claims to have proof of Irene and Arturo’s basic differences.

episodes.name: Episodio 15
episodes.plot: Time passes, and Fer answers Nora with increased defiance. Yeni’s circle celebrates. Details surface about Arturo’s tampering with the trial’s protocol.

episodes.name: Episodio 16
episodes.plot: A report about the trial’s protocol reaches the media, causing tension among the Huizars. Yeni meets with Nora — and defies her like never before.

episodes.name: Episodio 17
episodes.plot: Nora admits that Huizar Pharmaceuticals made a mistake. A shocking event claims casualties. Balo takes an unexpected action.

episodes.name: Episodio 18
episodes.plot: Years later, a posted video unleashes a nightmare for Yeni — and gives the Huizars hope. Francisco reminds Yeni that she now holds strong cards.

episodes.name: Episodio 19
episodes.plot: Nora asks Fer a controversial question. A surprise visitor arrives at Huizar Pharmaceuticals. Yeni experiences something heart-wrenching.

episodes.name: Episodio 20
episodes.plot: Pascal and Fer talk — unaware that they’re being overheard, and that the repercussions will be dramatic. Carlos chooses to share the whole truth.

episodes.name: Episodio 21
episodes.plot: Chaos breaks out at the Huizars’ home. Yeni says she's going to the police. Nora gets some overdue news, leaving her in distress — and angrier than ever.

episodes.name: Episodio 22
episodes.plot: Carlos e Julia sono piacevolmente sorpresi — e ignari del sinistro piano di Nora. Nel suo disperato tentativo, Arturo contrattacca, arruolando un alleato improbabile.

translations.value: Carlos e Julia sono piacevolmente sorpresi — e ignari del sinistro piano di Nora. Nel suo disperato tentativo, Arturo contrattacca, arruolando un alleato improbabile.

episodes.name: Episodio 23
episodes.plot: A hopeful meeting takes an unexpected turn — at least for Yeni. Arturo’s plan to frame Nora backfires in a tragic way.

episodes.name: Episodio 24
episodes.plot: Nora reproaches Fer. Yeni receives a heartfelt apology. A grim incident sets Nora’s long-term plan for Huizar Pharmaceuticals in motion.

translations.title: The Surrogacy
translations.overview: When a woman of humble origins is coerced into surrogacy, she becomes entangled with an affluent family who will protect their reputation at all costs.
Cuando una mujer de origen modesto se ve obligada a actuar como madre subrogada, se involucra con una poderosa familia que protegerá su propia reputación a toda costa.
